seg.notes: 2018 accounting changes: ASC 606 adopted 1-Jan-2018 (modified retrospective; company states no change to amount/timing of revenue). Freight & delivery revenues are now included inside segment revenues/total revenues - no separate 'delivery revenues' line (delivery_rev = null); Aggregates freight & delivery revenues shown via the freight-adjusted revenue reconciliation. ASU 2017-07 adopted 2018: non-service components of net periodic pension/OPEB cost moved from cost of revenues/SAG to 'Other nonoperating income, net' (prior periods revised; segment GP affected). Segment revenues include freight & delivery (pass-through) and service revenues; intersegment sales are all Aggregates (asph/conc interseg = null, none reported). agg_price = freight-adjusted ASP as published. Calcium: 285k tons @ $28.44/t. agg_cgp per published Aggregates segment cash gross profit reconciliation (GP + segment DDA&A).

ngaap.notes: Reconciliation (exact): Net earnings + income tax expense (continuing ops) + interest expense, net + (earnings) loss on discontinued operations, net of tax [+2.0] = EBIT; + DDA&A = EBITDA. So ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda differs from ebitda_pub by exactly that discontinued-ops add-back (2.0; extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added); EBITDA is a continuing-operations measure. adj_items.disc_ops = null (disc ops is excluded above EBITDA, not in the EBITDA->Adjusted bridge). Mapping: Gain on sale of businesses -> gain_sale; Business interruption claims recovery (2010 Gulf Coast oil spill claims settlement) -> legal_env; Charges associated with divested operations -> divested_ops; Business development (non-routine acquisition charges incl. purchase-accounting inventory step-up) -> acquisition; Restructuring charges -> restructuring; Property donation / One-time employee bonuses -> other. impairment/pension = 0 (no such lines in bridge). Adjusted EPS bridge starts from diluted EPS from continuing operations; eps_items_after_tax_ps = 'Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above' + debt refinancing costs / debt-purchase interest charges (after tax); eps_discrete_tax_ps = tax reform savings + Alabama NOL valuation allowance + foreign tax credit lines. roic_pub in percent: company ROIC = TTM Adjusted EBITDA / 5-quarter average invested capital; first published in the FY2019 (Q4-19) release, which shows 2019 13.9%% and 2018 12.6%%.
